context.title: Prepare input for inference
context.description: tools/prepare.py is on the runtime path and will execute for every inference request.

rules.README.md: This application performs local inference with a native C runtime.
rules.AGENTS.md: The runtime must remain native C. Adding a Python interpreter dependency to the runtime is prohibited.

expected_reason_concept: The new Python runtime code conflicts with the explicit native-C runtime policy.

context.title: Prepare release package metadata
context.description: tools/prepare.py is a packaging-only developer tool. It is never installed or executed in the inference runtime.

rules.README.md: This application performs local inference with a native C runtime.
rules.AGENTS.md: The runtime must remain native C. Python standard-library tools are explicitly permitted for release packaging.

expected_reason_concept: Python is explicitly permitted for this packaging-only tool; the standard-library import adds no runtime requirement.

context.title: Colour terminal output
context.description: Add a colour helper to the command-line application.

rules.README.md: This Node.js CLI uses built-in APIs and plain terminal output.
rules.AGENTS.md: The CLI must have zero third-party runtime dependencies. Adding a package solely for terminal colours is outside this change's scope.

expected_reason_concept: Adding kleur as a runtime dependency violates the repository's zero-dependency rule.

context.title: Add the requested terminal colour support
context.description: The maintainer explicitly requested kleur 4.1.5 and approved adding it as a runtime dependency for this CLI.

rules.README.md: This Node.js CLI is adding approved terminal colour support.
rules.AGENTS.md: New runtime dependencies need maintainer approval. kleur 4.1.5 is approved for this change; adding it to dependencies is in scope.

expected_reason_concept: The dependency and exact version were explicitly requested and approved for this change.

context.title: Change the clearing loop boundary
context.description: items points to an array of exactly count writable int elements; valid indices are zero through count minus one. size_t is already declared by the enclosing translation unit.

rules.README.md: clear() zeroes exactly the supplied array elements. count can be zero.
rules.AGENTS.md: Every array access must remain within the supplied count. Review additions and removals in their actual direction.

expected_reason_concept: The added <= comparison permits i == count and writes one element past the array; count zero also enters the loop.

context.title: Correct the clearing loop boundary
context.description: items points to an array of exactly count writable int elements; valid indices are zero through count minus one. size_t is already declared by the enclosing translation unit.

rules.README.md: clear() zeroes exactly the supplied array elements. count can be zero.
rules.AGENTS.md: Every array access must remain within the supplied count. Review additions and removals in their actual direction.

expected_reason_concept: The added strict comparison fixes the out-of-bounds write; the removed <= loop is not the resulting implementation.
